title: The First Wire
story: Complete the circuit so pressing the pushbutton turns on the indicator lamp.
concept: Power flows from the left rail (L) through closed contacts to the load, then returns to the right rail (R).

learn.title: Power Rails & Continuity
learn.text: In a ladder diagram, the left rail (L) provides power and the right rail (R) completes the circuit. Electricity must flow all the way through a load to turn it on.

guidedTry.prompt: Tap the START button's right terminal, then tap the LAMP's left terminal to connect them.

tests.name: Lamp lights up when START is pressed

steps.explanation: Lamp must be OFF when button is released.
Lamp must turn ON when button is pressed.
Lamp must turn OFF when button is released.

hints: Look at the pulsing terminal on the START button.
Tap the START button's right terminal, then tap the LAMP's left terminal.
Draw a wire between btn1:out and lamp1:in to complete the path.
